title: Mechanism‐Guided and Data‐Driven Design of COF/MOF Photocatalysts Toward H 2 O 2 Production
innovation: This review summarizes recent advances in COF/MOF photocatalysts for H 2 O 2 production, focusing on density functional theory (DFT)‐based mechanistic insights, descriptor construction, and data‐driven catalyst discovery enabled by artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML).
limitations: Likely sensitive to training-set coverage and transferability across chemistries. Electronic-structure trends may be stronger than finite-temperature dynamics, solvent, or kinetics.
next_steps: Test humid or multicomponent conditions and connect material metrics to process-level targets. Add kinetics, explicit environment effects, and active-site reconstruction checks.
mof_relevance: Directly relevant to MOF work, but likely less novel for this transfer-focused profile.
mof_transfer_route: Use as direct MOF prior art or a benchmark for a more specific MOF task.

title: Flexible force field-based screening and machine learning predictions for CO2 sorption and diffusion in MOFs
innovation: We investigated different ML algorithms, featurization methods, and the role of physical descriptors in predicting CO2 sorption and self-diffusion in MOFs.
limitations: Likely sensitive to training-set coverage and transferability across chemistries. Screening conclusions may depend on idealized structures, force fields, and missing defects/flexibility.
next_steps: Test humid or multicomponent conditions and connect material metrics to process-level targets. Benchmark uncertainty and out-of-domain behavior before broad screening claims.

mof_transfer_route: Use as direct MOF prior art or a benchmark for a more specific MOF task.

title: Mechanical versus thermal amorphization of ZIF-4: from local rearrangements to network disorder
innovation: Focusing on the two main synthesis methods, which are melt-quenching and ball-milling, we use molecular dynamics simulations with a machine-learning interatomic potential to compare different glasses obtained from ZIF-4.
limitations: Abstract-level evidence is promising, but validation breadth is unclear without reading the full paper.
next_steps: Test humid or multicomponent conditions and connect material metrics to process-level targets. Extend training to guest-loaded, distorted, and diffusion-transition configurations.
mof_relevance: Already in the MOF literature; keep it only if the method adds a new representation, label space, or uncertainty/active-learning angle.
mof_transfer_route: Use as direct MOF prior art or a benchmark for a more specific MOF task.
